info.title: pre.dev API
info.description: Public REST API for software specifications, browser automation, and credit balance. Base URL: https://api.pre.dev. MCP is documented separately at https://docs.pre.dev/mcp/tools.

post.description: Default: synchronous JSON. async=true returns an ID. stream=true takes precedence and returns SSE task_event, task_result, done (full result), or error. A matching retry key returns JSON even when stream=true. A disconnected client does not cancel execution.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional user-scoped 24-hour retry lookup. Reuse only for the same logical submission; concurrent first requests can still duplicate work.

200.description: Batch result, asynchronous ID, or SSE stream. Inspect Content-Type before parsing. A done batch can contain failed tasks; inspect each task status.

400.description: Invalid task input, malformed or unresolvable URL, missing instructions/output schema, or oversized batch. No work is started.

missing_instruction.summary: Task has no instruction or output schema

value.error: Task 1: Describe what the agent should do, or provide an output schema.
Task 1: Enter a full website URL, such as https://example.com.
A batch can contain at most 1000 tasks.

plan.description: The project's verified plan, once the spec is completed and its project has something planned or built. Absent otherwise.

SpecResponse.description: Full specification/status record. Fields may be absent or null until available. Terminal status is completed or failed. executionTime is milliseconds.

message.description: Optional detail; not returned by every endpoint.

generationsAvailable.description: Legacy field name containing the remaining credit balance, not a count of spec runs.

platform.description: Hostname extracted from the documentation URL (e.g., 'stripe.com', 'docs.github.com')

masterZipShortUrl.description: Short URL to download the zipped documentation archive for this platform

masterMarkdownShortUrl.description: Optional short URL to consolidated markdown file for this platform

category.description: Category of the technology (e.g., Frontend, Backend, Database)

name.description: Full name of the role (e.g., Full Stack Developer)

shortHand.description: Short abbreviation for the role (e.g., FSD)

subTasks.description: List of subtasks for this story

stories.description: List of user stories in this milestone

CodingAgentSpecJson.description: Simplified structured JSON for AI coding tools (excludes hours, personas, roles)

subTasks.description: List of subtasks for this story

stories.description: List of user stories in this milestone

HumanSpecJson.description: Full structured JSON with hours, personas, and roles for human review

totalHours.description: Total estimated hours for the project

creditsRemaining.description: Remaining credits. `null` on plans without a credit limit.

type.description: Node category; values depend on the graph.

level.description: Numeric flow depth or an architecture level such as C1 or C2, when available.

name.description: Name of the technology (e.g., React, PostgreSQL)

reason.description: Why this technology was chosen for this specific project

description.description: Technical description of what the technology does

helpfulLinks.description: Array of helpful documentation and tutorial links

alternatives.description: Array of alternative technologies that could be used instead

url.description: Full starting HTTP(S) URL. Domains must resolve to at least one IPv4 or IPv6 address.

instruction.description: Goal and constraints for the task.

input.description: Named string inputs available to the runner.

output.description: JSON Schema for extracted data. If omitted, the runner may infer a schema.

mode.description: auto chooses extraction when an output schema is provided; agent handles interaction.

maxSteps.description: Planning iteration budget. MCP accepts 1–50; use this range across clients. REST forwards the value without equivalent range validation.

maxDurationSeconds.description: Wall-clock budget in seconds. MCP accepts 5–600; use this range across clients. Defaults vary by execution path.

maxIterations.description: Legacy alias of maxSteps. If both are supplied, maxIterations takes precedence.

timeoutMs.description: Legacy millisecond budget. If both are supplied, timeoutMs takes precedence over maxDurationSeconds.

Task.description: A full HTTP(S) URL and either nonblank instructions or a non-empty output schema are required. The entire batch is validated before billing or queueing.

tasks.description: One or more tasks. Default server limit is 1,000, configurable by deployment; BATCH_TOO_LARGE reports the active limit.

concurrency.description: Requested parallelism; defaults to 5 and is clamped to 1–20. Account and service capacity may reduce effective parallelism.

async.description: Return the batch ID immediately, then poll or attach to its stream.

stream.description: Return SSE; takes precedence over async.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional retry lookup key. Idempotency-Key header takes precedence. User-scoped lookup lasts 24 hours; concurrent first requests are not atomically deduplicated.

status.description: PENDING and RUNNING are status placeholders; all other listed values are terminal task outcomes.

data.description: Extracted result; shape follows the requested or inferred schema. May be null or omitted.

creditsUsed.description: Settled task charge: every task keeps the 0.1-credit floor charged at submission; every status except ERROR and EXHAUSTED adds any usage above it.

anyOf.description: Queue estimate; 0 when running.

type.description: Extensible event type, for example navigation, screenshot, plan, action, validation, waiting, done, or error.

data.description: Event-specific payload. Screenshot data is not guaranteed to be a URL.

completed.description: Counts result slots, including pending/running placeholders or nulls. Do not use this as the completion signal.

results.description: Ordered by task index. Slots can be null or partial until a result arrives.

liveEvents.description: Per-task events when includeEvents=true and live events are available.

total.description: Current inflight count reported by the queue snapshot.

cap.description: Current account inflight limit, resolved by tier. Treat this as a snapshot, not a reservation.

anyOf.description: Short URL for uploaded file (if file was uploaded)
Name of uploaded file (if file was uploaded)
Processing time in milliseconds (only when completed or failed)

SpecSummary.description: Summary only. Use GET /spec-status/{specId} for Markdown, JSON, graphs, totalHumanHours, creditsUsed, and progressMessage.

completed.description: Count of stored task results in this history response.

results.description: Compact preview, not a complete result set. Use GET /browser-agent/{id} for details.

BrowserCapacity.description: Advisory service diagnostics. Fields may change; perUserCap is a legacy global value, not your account limit. Use GET /browser-agent-status for your cap.

url.description: Credential-bearing WebSocket URL. Keep private and use only for the requested batch.

name.description: The feature in the owner's words.

status.description: From pre.dev's checks. works: a check of this feature passed at the current code. built_not_checked: the code is there, nothing has proven it. changed_since_check: its files changed after its check passed. needs_a_look: its check failed the last time it ran. not_working: its check keeps failing. in_progress, planned: not built yet. out_of_scope: set outside the project's scope, not counted. removed: taken out because the owner asked, not counted.

statusText.description: The words pre.dev shows, for example "Works, checked 2 h ago".

scope.description: proposed: suggested by pre.dev and not counted until the owner confirms it.

removedParts.description: Parts the owner asked to take out of this feature.

id.description: For example features_built, env_keys, data_persisted, sign_in, sample_data, publish_build, live_current, live_saves.

how.description: What to do in plain words: where to click on pre.dev, or what to ask a coding agent to do.

ProjectPlan.description: A project's verified plan: what it is for, each feature's status from pre.dev's checks, progress, Ready to launch, where things live in the code, and the last change.

codeVersion.description: The code version the plan was computed at; null before any code exists.

text.description: What the app is for, in one paragraph.

proposedByPredev.description: Proposed by pre.dev from the request and not edited by the owner yet.

removedSince.description: Taken out since, as the owner asked.

provenWorking.description: Built and proven working by a check at the current code.

proposed.description: Suggested features, not counted until confirmed.

anyOf.description: Where things live in the code. Each list holds at most 25 items; count is the full number.
File and line in the code, for example server/routes.js:42, or the file alone.
File and line in the code, for example server/routes.js:42, or the file alone.
File and line in the code, for example server/routes.js:42, or the file alone.
The last run that changed the code.

kind.description: chat (an ask) or sprint (a build of planned work).

markdown.description: The plan as Markdown for a coding agent.
